Formula mean_c = sum_{k in W_c} x_k / n_c; s_c = sqrt(sum_{k in W_c} (x_k - mean_c)^2 / n_c) (population deviation, centred second pass). W_c = the valid cells of the square or circular window around cell c, clipped at the raster edge; n_c = their count. The result is nodata (NaN) when n_c < max(minimumCount, 1), or when the cell itself is nodata and propagateCenterNoData is set.
